channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Friday's tape finally moves. The AWS Capacity Blocks live table now prints the rates that sat in the banner since 7 Oct: P5 $5.970 (was $5.191), P5e $6.866, P5en $7.895, P6-B200 $14.208, and P6-B300 $16.146. DigitalOcean AMD spot also jumped, with MI355X at $5.50 (was $2.97) and MI350X at $3.50 (was $2.46). On conversion, Applied Digital locked access to up to 1 GW of potential power in Finland for a first non-US AI Factory campus (initial power from 2028, counterparty unnamed), and DarkHorse signed up to 50 MW with Hopkinsville Electric System for a new Kentucky superintelligence factory, doubling its TVA-region contracted power to about 100 MW. The rest of the public rental tape is a confirm session: 62 confirms, 7 ticks, 0 NEW across Lambda, CoreWeave NA and EU, Crusoe, DigitalOcean, GCP TPU and AWS Capacity Blocks.

item.title: Compute brief - 9 October 2026
item.description: Friday's tape finally moves. The AWS Capacity Blocks live table now prints the rates that sat in the banner since 7 Oct: P5 $5.970 (was $5.191), P5e $6.866, P5en $7.895, P6-B200 $14.208, and P6-B300 $16.146. DigitalOcean AMD spot also jumped, with MI355X at $5.50 (was $2.97) and MI350X at $3.50 (was $2.46). On conversion, Applied Digital locked access to up to 1 GW of potential power in Finland for a first non-US AI Factory campus (initial power from 2028, counterparty unnamed), and DarkHorse signed up to 50 MW with Hopkinsville Electric System for a new Kentucky superintelligence factory, doubling its TVA-region contracted power to about 100 MW. The rest of the public rental tape is a confirm session: 62 confirms, 7 ticks, 0 NEW across Lambda, CoreWeave NA and EU, Crusoe, DigitalOcean, GCP TPU and AWS Capacity Blocks. Countries: Finland: Applied Digital access to up to 1 GW potential power for first non-US AI Factory campus; initial power from 2028; marketing to hyperscalers; counterparty unnamed (Wire, 6 Oct). United States / Kentucky: DarkHorse up to 50 MW with Hopkinsville Electric System; funds 65 MW HES substation on TVA 161 kV; TVA-region contracted power to ~100 MW; permits pending (Wire, 6 Oct). United States / Texas: AZIO AI first Atlas One hosting agreement with Power Champion: 10 MW contracted, expansion rights to 50 MW; no capacity energized; export-control and infrastructure conditions (Signal, 9 Oct). India: CoreWeave sole tenant of 3 x 80 MW at AdaniConneX Taloja, Navi Mumbai still the Asia neocloud headline from 7 Oct (Wire). United States / Wyoming: Black Hills definitive agreements through 2048 for Google's planned Cheyenne campus (Wire, 6 Oct); Wyoming PSC transmission CPCNs still pending.
